_comment: Copy to settings.json (the stack window writes it for you). Empty = the default in brackets.
_data_root: [<repo>\data] builds, ROM extracts and textures go to <data_root>\work and <data_root>\classic
_roms: [<repo>oms] the folder holding your own srallyc.zip
_sr3_game: [the game: line of setup.yaml] SEGA Rally 3's folder, the one with Rally.exe

_mame: [none] mame.exe, only for recording the 1995 music
